notes.title: Steam Achievements and the future
notes.notes:
Greetings!
S.H.E.L.T.E.R. An Apocalyptic Tale now has 14 achievements for you to discover. Can you find all of them?
 
We would like to also announce that we are working hard on a new game in a sci-fi setting that will be announced soon. 

After collecting your priceless feedback and expanding the studio thanks to your 
support, we are getting ready to invite you to a bigger and more nonlinear journey! 

We hope you are as excited as we are for what the future will bring and we thank you for your patience!

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. - An Apocalyptic Tale Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're proud to announce that the final update of the game is here and is ready to be played and experienced by you.  

Please let us know if you have encountered any bugs or problems and we'll fix them as fast as possible.


We'd also appreciate if you could share your experience with the game and tell us what you'd like to see in our future project. 

With that we'd like to thank you for your support! It was an amazing year of development and we couldn't have made it without you.


Changelog:

[list]
[*]You can reach the game's endgame now. For that, visit your office and click on the [i]final encounter[/i]. The choices you've made will change the ending you'll get, as well as the epilogues.
[*] 
[spoiler] 2 optional scenes with the Bandit Leader/Dagger. [/spoiler] 

[/list]

notes.title: Full Release of S.H.E.L.T.E.R.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

we're proud and happy to announce that we'll be releasing the full version of the game on[b]November 12[/b].

The last update will feature the epilogues for the characters and a few scenes. 

We'd like to thank you for accompanying us on this journey for the last year. 

Your feedback and suggestions helped us shape the game and get it to the best shape possible.


Stay tuned for our future projects!

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 5
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the 5th Update for S.H.E.L.T.E.R.

This will update the game to Version 0.34. 

This is the pre-last update of the game. 

The Full release is planned for November with epilogues to the main story.

Changelog:

[list]
[*] You can now impregnate Lucy and have a child with her as well as pregnant scenes.

[*] You can now impregnate Mandisa and have a child with her as well as pregnant scenes.

[*] You can now corrupt Mandisa.
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy this update and stay tuned.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 4
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the 4th Update for S.H.E.L.T.E.R.
This will update the game to Version 0.32.

Changelog:
[list]

[*] You can now impregnate Grace and have a child with her. 

[*] You can now get Angela, Melisa and Kira their requested items when they're pregnant and get rewarded for it.

[*] You can have new scenes with the corrupted Mia

[*] There are threesome scenes with Kira and Melisa that can be accessed through the player's room.


[/list]


We hope you will enjoy this update.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 3
notes.notes:
We are excited to release the third major update to S.H.E.L.T.E.R. 
This will update the game to Version 0.30.

Changelog:
[list]

[*] You can now impregnate Mia and have a child with her. 

[*] If the greenhouse started to produce food, you can take some of it back to the shelter and have a proper meal.

[*] You can now upgrade your car with one of three upgrades. This is the last upgrade before the final confrontation with the bandits so choose wisely.

[*] You can now Corrupt Mia if Grace is corrupted.  Her scenes in corrupted form will come later.

[*] New scenes with Bandit Leader and Mia. 6 new sex scenes overall.


[/list]


We hope you will enjoy this update.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Trading cards are now available for the game and you can now collect them by playing it. Collect the whole set and you can unlock unique badges, backgrounds and emotes. 

We hope you will enjoy this new addition while we are working on the next update for the game.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 2
notes.notes:
We are happy to introduce the second major update for S.H.E.L.T.E.R. which will update the game to version 0.28.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] You can now plan second operation in the armory and get another upgrade for settlement’s defense.

[*] You can also scavenge the military base for supply

[*] Android can now create a baby (romance route only) and get a job in the settlement.

[*] Lucy can now be completely cured or only get her voice back (depending on your previous choice).

[*] New outfit for Melisa that comes with 3 new sex scenes.

[*] The Bandit Leader will now visit you a week after your second encounter and you can choose to get to know her better.

[*] New sex scenes with Android, Lucy, Bandit Leader, Melisa, Mandisa and a scene with Angela, Kira and    Melisa if you are on their harem romance route. [b]13 new sex scenes overall[/b].

[*] Fixed various typos and issues with the gallery.

[/list]

The [b]next update[/b] is scheduled to release in [b]May[/b].

We hope you enjoy this update. If you encounter any bugs or problems, please let us know and we will fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 1
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience and support, we are happy to announce the release of the first major update of S.H.E.L.T.E.R. which will update the game to version 0.26.

This update will introduce new content to the routes and to the main story, which will setup events in the future.


Changelog:

[list]
[*] Pregnancy content for Tiffany, Jay and Elin.
[*] You can now decide who has the right to own weapons in the settlement and upgrade armory.
[*] Continuation of Grace’s and Lucy’s story. New sex scenes with Tiffany, Jay, Elin, Mandisa, Grace, Mia, Lucy and Bandit Leader. [b]19 New sex scenes overall.[/b]
[*] The Bandit Leader will now visit you after a week since your first encounter[spoiler]where you might reach the first bad ending of the game depending on your choice.[/spoiler] 
[*] Steam Cloud to store your save files.
[*] New music tracks were added.
[/list]

[b]The approximate date for the next release will be at the end of March.[/b]


We hope you enjoy this update. If you encounter any bugs or problems, please let us know and we will fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Hotfix 0.22a
notes.notes:
We have gathered some feedback and decided to release a hotfix that should help with some issues, that were encountered, thank you for your continuous support and ideas. 
We are looking forward to improving S.H.E.L.T.E.R. as much as possible!


[u][b]S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Hotfix 0.22a

[/b][/u][b]Changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed reported typos, errors and graphical bugs.
[*] Adjusted some scenes to keep the story consistent.
[*] Moved the counter of the cans into the button for better visibility in darker backgrounds.
[*] Added the option to change the opacity of the textbox in the preference slider, but it will also apply itself at the start of scenes.
[*] Added the option to make Oscar, Kira, Angela and Melisa your friends instead of your family in the preference screen as well as on the first start up. 
[/list]
[b]To change relationships mid game: [/b]
[olist]
[*] 	Load the save you want to change.
[*] 	Open the Preference Menu (Right click or navigation bar).
[*] 	Choose if you want to have Incest On or Off.
[*] 	Press Apply.
[/olist]
[b]Important[/b]: Do not rollback after you pressed apply, else you might have to restart the process.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. An Apocalyptic Tale - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
S.H.E.L.T.E.R. is ready and we are excited for you to experience the game.

Today at 8am PT we will go live and we hope you will share the excitement, we have developing the game but we think we will be able to offer you an adult game that is both unique and rewarding.

We hope to keep in touch with you guys and if you have any questions, feel free to post in the forums and gives us your thoughts!

Thank you,

Winterlook Games
